authority: Supreme Court of the United Kingdom

steps.title: Investigation and Arrest
steps.description: Police investigate alleged criminal conduct and may arrest suspects in accordance with the Police and Criminal Evidence Act 1984.

steps.title: Charging Decision
steps.description: Crown Prosecution Service reviews evidence and decides whether to charge the suspect.

steps.title: First Court Appearance
steps.description: Accused appears before the Magistrates’ Court for initial hearing, including plea and bail decisions.

steps.title: Case Allocation
steps.description: Case is allocated to Magistrates’ Court or sent to the Crown Court depending on offence seriousness.

steps.title: Trial
steps.description: Trial is conducted with examination of evidence and witnesses in the appropriate court.

steps.title: Verdict
steps.description: Court delivers verdict of guilty or not guilty.

steps.title: Sentencing
steps.description: If convicted, court imposes sentence in accordance with applicable law.

documents_required: Case file submitted by Crown Prosecution Service

escalation_paths.condition: Appeal against conviction or sentence as permitted by law
Appeal against conviction or sentence as permitted by law

escalation_paths.to: Supreme Court of the United Kingdom
escalation_paths.condition: Appeal on a point of law of general public importance
